purpose: Deepen sparse-state coverage with cross-domain security, AI evaluation, biological custody, simulation-code, laboratory-coding and supply-chain observations while keeping all identifier matches nonphysical.

policy.rule: Useful raw occurrences are retained across all domains with zero automatic physical-evidence weight.
policy.promotion: CVE, article, catalog, LOINC and repository identifiers never promote a target to P1/P2 without independent physical-value evidence.
policy.no_hit: Sparse and no-hit states remain priority search targets and may accumulate later observations append-only.
